action.old_text: raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
action.new_text:
# Validate inputs
    arrays = [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]
    for arr in arrays:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("Each input matrix must be two-dimensional")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must be nonpositive")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must be finite")
    # Check shape consistency
    shape = arrays[0].shape
    for arr in arrays[1:]:
        if arr.shape != shape:
            raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, (bool, np.bool_)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a Boolean value")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    n_candidates, horizon = shape
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw_weights / np.sum(raw_weights)
    # Compute weighted averages
    wavg_result = np.sum(logp_with_result * weights, axis=1)
    wavg_call = np.sum(logp_call_only * weights, axis=1)
    wavg_no_call = np.sum(logp_no_call * weights, axis=1)
    # Compute margins
    margins = wavg_result - np.maximum(wavg_call, wavg_no_call)
    keep = margins > tau_filter
    return keep, margins
